messages:
jamal: PhotonWorks confirmed they want a private install next week. They mentioned proxy with auth and Secure Boot enforced across fleet. Need preflight guidance.
dirti: pinging infra for driver/secure-boot checklist.
irene: Summary of blockers we usually see: proxy auth for image pulls, unsigned kernel modules (NV), kube version mismatch, and node kernel ABI mismatches. For Secure Boot we either (A) have customer sign the NV modules with their MOK keys, or (B) run a temporary maintenance window to disable Secure Boot for installer + sign + re-enable. Both take time.
dmitri (PhotonWorks): Ops would prefer not to disable Secure Boot. They asked how much work signing is. Also want to know if installer can use a proxy with basic auth.
sam: Installer supports proxy env vars (HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY) but it does not prompt for interactive auth. We can accept pre-configured proxy creds via a secure temp file or a secrets object during install. Need to verify their proxy uses NTLM (unsupported) vs basic/digest (supported).
security: If they provide proxy creds we need an approval ticket and a short retention policy. We recommend ephemeral creds that expire after the installer run.
jamal: Action items for PhotonWorks to return before we schedule:
- output of `nvidia-smi -q | head -n 25`
- `sudo mokutil --sb-state` (Secure Boot state)
- `openssl s_client -connect proxy.company:443 -servername proxy.company` (to confirm cert chain) or proxy root CA installed on nodes
- proxy type (basic/digest/NTLM) and whether they can create a temporary service account for outbound
- `kubectl get nodes -o jsonpath='{.items[*].status.nodeInfo.kubeletVersion}'`
- `ls /sys/module/nvidia/parameters` (if present)

dmitri (PhotonWorks): Posting quick outputs:
```
$ sudo mokutil --sb-state
SecureBoot enabled
$ nvidia-smi -q | head -n 5
==============NVSMI LOG==============\nTimestamp                           : Wed Mar 09 2026 12:03:11\nDriver Version                      : 470.142\nCUDA Version                        : 11.0\nAttached GPUs                       : 4\nGPU 00000000:3B:00.0
```
Proxy: corporate proxy that uses NTLM. We can create a service principal for basic auth if needed, but that needs AD ticketing.

irene: NTLM is a hard stop for automated installs. Two options: (1) PhotonWorks configures a temporary basic-auth proxy endpoint (recommended), or (2) we run the installer from an internal bastion host that has unencumbered egress (we'll need SSH access + bastion user).
sam: For module signing: we can provide instructions to generate a MOK and sign the NV modules. Steps we usually give: `sudo /usr/src/linux-headers-$(uname -r)/scripts/sign-file sha256 privkey.pem pubkey.der $(modinfo -n nvidia)` and enroll MOK with `mokutil --import pubkey.der`. This requires reboots per node and a key enrollment window.
security: Also ensure HSM/KMS keys for any secrets we write into cluster; we can't persist raw proxy creds. Use a Kubernetes secret with expire annotation, or upload into our ephemeral vault during install.
jamal: Proposed plan depending on PhotonWorks choice:
- If they can provide basic-auth proxy: schedule preflight today, run signing in maintenance window tomorrow, install Wed.
- If they need bastion: they provision bastion + SSH keys, we run install from bastion Fri. Extra ops time ~4h.

dmitri (PhotonWorks): We'll ask AD team to mint a basic proxy service account. Also will check if they can run enrollment for MOK themselves (ops prefers to keep keys), otherwise they'll let us handle signing during maintenance.
ops-bot: Ticket #SR-2102 created for PhotonWorks POC proxy/auth + mok signing. Owner: jamal. ETA update required in 48h.
jamal: Great. Irene, can you draft the exact step-by-step commands for MOK signing and a minimal proxy test script we can hand to PhotonWorks? I'll attach to the ticket.
irene: On it  will post the doc and the quick test snippet here.
sam: One small note: if they upgrade drivers to >=525 before install we avoid a bunch of kernel/module mismatch headaches. Recommend adding driver upgrade to the runbook.
dmitri (PhotonWorks): Understood. We'll prioritize driver upgrade and proxy service account. Will post confirmation in this thread.
jamal: Perfect. If anything stalls, @security escalate and we'll regroup. Thanks everyone.
